media:group.media:title: The Perfect Kirby Speedrun, Explained [COMMENTATED TAS]
media:group.media:description:
This is a Tool Assisted Speedrun (with commentary!), which means that I used fancy computer tools and way too much knowledge of this game to create a theoretically perfect speedrun. It is not meant to be compared to actual speedruns, it is merely to demonstrate what the game would look like if people were literally perfect. aka it's real fast
